titolo: NVIDIA launches Alpamayo 2 Edge, a 2 billion‑parameter VLA for DRIVE AGX Thor
descr: Alpamayo 2 Edge delivers vision‑language‑action reasoning for autonomous driving with 160‑190 ms pixel‑to‑trajectory latency on NVIDIA’s DRIVE AGX Thor platform.
paragrafi: NVIDIA announced Alpamayo 2 Edge, a new vision‑language‑action model designed for autonomous‑driving tasks.
The model contains roughly 2 billion parameters and can plan driving trajectories while providing explanations for its decisions.
Alpamayo 2 Edge runs on NVIDIA’s DRIVE AGX Thor hardware, achieving a pixel‑to‑trajectory latency between 160 ms and 190 ms.
The release was reported on 22 November 2026 by both MarkTechPost and the official Hugging Face model page.
The model is available through the nvidia/Alpamayo2-Edge repository on Hugging Face.
perche: For developers of autonomous‑driving systems, Alpamayo 2 Edge offers a ready‑to‑use reasoning VLA that fits the performance envelope of existing DRIVE Thor hardware. Users seeking free or locally hosted models will still rely on community‑driven alternatives, as Alpamayo 2 Edge is tied to NVIDIA’s proprietary platform.
